brief:
The Palestinian Centre for Human Rights condemned ongoing Israeli military operations in the Gaza Strip, reporting that civilians including children were killed and injured over a four-day period, PCHR said. The strikes targeted civilian gatherings, displacement tents, homes, and other civilian property across the territory.

PCHR characterised the operations as part of what it described as genocide. The organisation did not provide specific casualty figures or identify individual incidents in its statement, but said the pattern of attacks demonstrated a systematic campaign against the civilian population.
dek: The Palestinian Centre for Human Rights (PCHR) condemns the ongoing targeting of civilians and civilian objects by the Israeli Occupation Forces (IOF) in the Gaza Strip. Over the past four days, several Palestinians, including children, have been killed and injured in a wave of attacks targeting civilian gatherings, displacement tents, homes, and civilian property. PCHR.
title: Palestinian rights group documents Israeli strikes killing civilians in Gaza
